notes.title: Issues Fixed - Small Update
notes.notes:
The issues with the game attempting to connect to the wrong server has been fixed. From now on, you won't be required to have an active connection to the servers, but the game will refuse to start if you are not connected to Steam.

As a warning, I was forced to push previously unreleased content. Although it's minor changes, bugs still may occur. Please report any in the Discord server or in the community hub for the game.

I apologize for the issues with the game.

notes.title: FULL RELEASE | The Backrooms Deluxe v1.0
notes.notes:
[h2]RELEASE[/h2]

The game is now [b]released[/b]. Thank you so much to anyone who supported me through this journey.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added multiplayer
[*] Grass now disappears when your foliage (or overall) graphics are set to Low (Level 94)
[*] Fixed some bugs with the levels not replicating correctly (Levels 37, 34 and 6 still aren't perfectly replicated in multiplayer)
[*] Optimized Level 37
[*] Optimized Level 5
[*] Much more...
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.17.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hotfix: 0.17.1[/h2]

[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[list]
[*] QoL Features
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Added a way to change the lean left-right keybind (ingame pause menu only)
[*] Renamed the invulnerable difficulty to "Practice"
[*] Added a new account system (for multiplayer once multiplayer and the level editor come out)
[*] Sanity system disabled in practice mode
[/list]

[b]Special thanks to ojpme for playtesting and helping me find bugs and issues.[/b]
